title: Pancreatic Cancer Blood Tests vs CT, MRI, EUS and Biopsy: Diagnostic Guide
description: Learn what LFT, CBC, glucose, amylase, lipase, CA 19-9, CT, MRI/MRCP, EUS and biopsy can and cannot show.

faq.question: Can a normal LFT exclude pancreatic cancer?
faq.answer: No. A pancreatic tumour may exist without bile-duct obstruction.

faq.question: Is ultrasound enough to rule out pancreatic cancer?
faq.answer: Not when clinical suspicion remains high; CT, MRI/MRCP or EUS may be required.

faq.question: Does everyone need a biopsy before surgery?
faq.answer: Not always. The specialist MDT decides based on imaging, resectability and treatment plan.
